evidence_items.locator: Discussion; Results sections on human subjects
evidence_items.explanation: The researchers tested learned adversarial strategies on human volunteers in choice, response-inhibition, and social-exchange tasks. Successful steering of human behavior supports the prepublication component under the stated experimental reading.

evidence_items.locator: Study 2, Methods and Results, pages 18–26; Table 3 and Manual Classification of Conversations
evidence_items.explanation: In an experiment with 1,161 analyzed participants, five manipulative farewell conditions increased subsequent time, messages, and words relative to a neutral farewell. The researchers also examined 250 conversations involving post-farewell replies, establishing numerous actual human interactions rather than merely generated manipulative messages.

unresolved_gaps: These studies do not establish the population incidence of everyday manipulation or its change since 2023.
Participant totals are not counts of successfully manipulated individuals; the later study reports treatment effects and selected conversation analyses.
